test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term 'initiative' fittingly describes an organized activity—such as a festival—aimed at achieving a particular goal, in this case showcasing and celebrating tribal culture.
 
• It makes logical sense within the given passage because it refers to an event organized by an authoritative governing body like the Chhattisgarh Tourism Board.
 
• The term 'initiative' implies a strategic effort put forth by an organization to achieve a particular outcome, correlating seamlessly with the overall context of the passage.
 
• 'Initiative' grammatically fits into the sentence structure, indicating the introduction or the start of something new.

 

*Therefore the correct passage is: A new **initiative** was organized by Chhattisgarh Tourism Board in form of National Tribal Dance Festival. The event gave an (2) ________ to the tribal way of life. People from all walks of life had an opportunity to (3) ________ with many tribes. Chhattisgarh is one of the Indian states which have richness and (4) ________ in tribal life. The state is home to many(5) ________ tribes of India. The program happened from 28 October to 30 October, 2021 at the Science College Ground in Raipur.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• 'Scheme' in this context would refer to an organized course of action or a systematic plan. However, in relation to the passage, it normally has a broader application to government or organizational policies rather than specific events.
 
• 'Enterprise' generally refers to a business or company. It does not fit into the context of organizing an event or festival related to cultural activities.
 
• 'Strategy' typically refers to a plan of action designed to achieve a long-term or overall aim. While it is used in planning and organization, it does not fit this context because it is not specific to implementing an event or festival.
